# BarrierConditionedTrajectory

**Domain**: TCC
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
A path in state space that is statistically forced to cross a predefined decision boundary, derived from conditioning a stochastic process on an absorbing or reflecting barrier. Enables topology-aware control of information flow in noisy networks, allowing precise routing of signals through physical substrates with inherent randomness.
